exposure: epidural volume extension with normal saline
intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine combined with spinal epidural
cohort: 60 parturients undergoing elective caesarean section at the Institute of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Madras Medical College
finding: Combined spinal epidural anaesthesia with normal saline resulted in more stable systolic blood pressure, reduced motor blockade duration, and no adverse effects compared to intrathecal hyperbaric bupivacaine alone in elective caesarean sections.
